Then, the synthesized ingots were extruded into 3.3 mm thick sheets at 713 K (Figure 1(b)).
To obtain HEAp/AMCs sheets with identical initial state before cryorolling except for mass fraction of HEAp, these sheets were annealed at 713 K for 1 hour.

evidence.quote: Therefore, the tensile deformation performance of the model at cryogenic temperature was better than that at room temperature due to inhibition or delay in the failure of the material caused by the voids.
The formation and growth of cracks in the Tensile-173 HEAp/AMCs were inhibited in cryogenic environment, resulted in the increased elongation.
